newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 31.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- French politicians break silence on Algerian crisis. Foreign affairs minister Herve de Charette criticises TV address by Algeria's president Liamine Zeroual and former President Valery Giscard d'Estaing says he would like to see all sides taking part in upcoming elections in Algeria.
-- French economic situation shows signs of improvement with 29,000 fewer jobseekers in December, unemployment rate unchanged at 12.7 percent.
-- Paris bourse soars on company results and improving economic situation.
-- Bank of France cuts intervention rate to 3.10 percent.
-- Unions at state-owned railroad operator SNCF call for strike on February 5 against planned reform.
-- AXA-UAP sells stake in reinsurance firm Scor. Paper says group Credit National-BFCE may be next on the list of possible asset sales.
-- France Telecom bets on an opening of the Chinese market to competition, seeks to widen mobile phone partnership signed for two towns to areas of China.
-- Bouygues Telecom to upgrade its investment programme, seeks to raise some 23 billion francs through year 2000 including some 15 billion borrowed from banks.
